name: Moe & Curly's Pub (West Maple)
description: Moe and Curlys is a lively karaoke bar known for its great sound system, friendly staff, and vibrant crowd. It offers karaoke every night of the week, creating a welcoming environment for both casual singers and regulars. The venue stands out with its affordable drinks, fun atmosphere, and occasional themed nights, making it a popular spot for locals seeking a fun, relaxed night of singing and socializing.
